required_changes_injected: CRITERION 2 VIOLATION — Decision Criteria regressed from 8/10 (Identified) in cumulative state to 5/10 (Partial) in current analysis without documented reason. Cumulative state explicitly marked this as 'identified' with comprehensive evidence. Current analysis downgrades to 'Partial' claiming 'criteria surfaced through seller-led demos rather than prospect-stated evaluation framework' — but this is a reinterpretation of the same evidence, not new contradictory information from the recent calls. The two new calls (07-13 and 08-04) add detail (SQL-based integration, retroactive metrics, bot filtering, multi-armed experiments, API/webhooks, visual editor, Figma import, Sixsense integration) but do NOT contradict the identified status. Analysis must maintain Decision Criteria at Identified/8/10 and note 'Call 2 adds technical depth to previously identified criteria; no regression in prospect validation.' CRITERION 3 VIOLATION — Metrics score of 4/10 lacks evidence of prospect-stated value metrics. Analysis correctly identifies that 'quantifiable business outcomes have not been stated by the prospect' but then scores 4/10 instead of 1-2/10 (Unknown). A score of 4/10 implies partial evidence of metrics; the analysis itself proves none exist. Should be 1/10 Unknown with note 'No prospect-originated metrics stated across two calls.' CRITERION 4 VIOLATION — Champion next step uses vague language: 'If Dani has not yet shared the pitch, that is a champion risk that must be surfaced now' is observation, not actionable next step. Rewrite as: '[contact TBD or Dani]: Confirm by [date] whether consolidation pitch has been shared internally and with whom; request introduction to VP or budget owner if pitch has landed.' CRITERION 5 VIOLATION — ICP Fit section claims 'Confirmed' but uses only seller-stated positioning ('GrowthBook positioned as...') without prospect confirmation of fit. Rewrite to: 'Strong ICP alignment based on: Box runs multiple web experiments (stated Call 2), uses modern data stack (GCP warehouse, Adobe Target), publicly traded SaaS with 100K+ users. No explicit disqualifiers present. ICP fit: Likely but not yet confirmed by prospect.'
